questions.answer: Getting the biggest culture shock possible. Learning about a country important to the world economy.

questions.answer: Off campus

questions.answer: Pretty easy, there are multiple english speaking agents in Shanghai that can be found on the internet

questions.answer: Fudan is pretty off center. Gives great flexibility to live off campus, at the cost of higher rent

questions.answer: There were multiple ambiguous emails telling you to register different ways. Contact staff.

questions.answer: 1 day orientation- took about 45 minutes

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: Mainly email

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: I got the courses i wanted

questions.answer: If you receive multiple instructions, e-mail to confirm the correct.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: MA

questions.question: Did you take BA or MA classes while you were on exchange *
questions.answer: MA

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: Not very theory driven, very empirical. Although the courses were stated to be Master level, a lot of BA students were also present.

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: More emphasis of engaging with students compared to UCPH, but less structured.

questions.answer: 1 semester

Get the apps
Haggle/be pushy, you can usually get your way if you insist
